description: Reson8 (Resonate Labs B.V.) is a Netherlands-based speech-to-text provider that runs its own GPU infrastructure in the Netherlands with zero audio retention. It sells prerecorded, realtime and turn-detection transcription APIs (Rumble-2, Rumble-2-Flash, Resonant-1) with custom vocabulary, focused on European languages and domain terminology; Rumble-2-Flash is also published as open weights.
name: Reson8
